correctness.rationale: The exact double-scaled quadratic update reduces to t+=t|1-gamma F_rho(t)| with t=ell|x|, F_rho(t)=(1+t+rho)/(1+(2+rho)t+t²). F decreases strictly and t F increases strictly for t>=0, rho>=0. If gamma<=2/(1+rho), positive amplitudes strictly decrease to zero; at equality Taylor gives t_k~(1+rho)/[2(1+3rho+rho²)k]. Above the threshold the unique p>0 solves gamma F(p)=2, while monotone tF proves strict contraction of |t-p| on (0,2p), with eventual entrance from t>=2p unless finite zero hit. Thus every nonterminating orbit approaches the nonzero sign-alternating two-cycle. Rational checks verify direct reduction and a specific exact 2-cycle; this is not a general-function theorem.
